title: A Way Back Uphill

plate.narration: A griffin leans over the ridge and lowers a rope ladder. Its bottom rung swings above the rising water. Up on the rocks, a dry path winds toward the pass. Time to climb.

goal.text: Find a dry way back uphill toward the mountain pass.

steps.label: Set the ladder on firm ground

bank.narration: You come out on the stony shore under the Frostfang Peaks. Behind you, the river is climbing the stones. A griffin calls down from a low ridge. "I am Tamsin! I keep the river line for the griffin aerie up here. The water is rising. Is everyone here?" She waves a wing and nearly falls off. Tonight your job is to find a dry way back uphill, to the mountain pass called the Cairnstep.

count.narration: "Good!" calls Tamsin. "Stay put. My ladder is stuck under a rock." The water licks your boots. Your rope is tangled, and your packs sit right where the river wants them. What comes first?

count_rope.narration: You pick the knots loose. A tiny silver fish flips out of a loop and back into the river. It looks offended. Soon the rope sits in a neat coil.

count_packs.narration: You carry the packs up to a flat rock. One pack goes glug. You pour out a cupful of river and one very confused pebble.

help.narration: Tamsin's ladder pops free. She lowers a rope ladder down the cliff, and its bottom rung swings above the water. "I can hold the top," she calls. "But if the bottom swings, the first climber rings like a bell. Can you set it on firm ground?"

ladder.narration: Everyone grabs the foot of the ladder. The wet rope is as slippery as a fish. A flat dry rock sits a few steps up. "On three!" calls Tamsin. "One, two, heave!"

haul_foot.prompt: Everyone heave the ladder's foot onto the flat rock.

onSuccess.narration: The foot slides onto the rock with a crunch.

onFailure.narration: The foot slips back and bumps your shins. You settle for a rock that is mostly dry.

lash_foot.prompt: Tie the ladder's foot to the boulder with a knot that holds.
lash_foot.narration: You loop your rope around a boulder. You know a few knots.

onSuccess.narration: The knot pulls tight. The ladder stops swinging.

onFailure.narration: The knot is a clumsy lump, but it holds. The ladder will wobble a bit.

brace_foot.prompt: Use brace to hold the ladder still while the others set its foot.
brace_foot.narration: Your thornguard plants both feet and holds the ladder still.

onSuccess.narration: The foot settles on the rock like a hen on an egg.

onFailure.narration: The foot settles with a wobble. It will have to do.

smash_foot.prompt: Use smash to lift the ladder's foot onto the rock.
smash_foot.narration: Your bigfoot scoops up the ladder's foot like a loaf of bread.

onSuccess.narration: It lands on the rock with a thump that shakes the pebbles.

onFailure.narration: It lands a bit crooked. It will have to do.

foot_set.narration: The ladder's foot sits on the rock, steady. Tamsin tests it and squawks happily. "Somebody hold it, and somebody climb three rungs."

variants.text: The ladder's foot sits on the rock, but it wobbles. "It will do," says Tamsin. "Somebody hold it, and somebody climb three rungs."

ladder_hold.narration: Looking fine and being fine are different things. One hero climbs. The others hold the ladder still.

interaction.cue: Hold the ladder steady while your friend climbs three rungs.

onSuccess.narration: Not a wobble. "Now look along the shore," says Tamsin.

onFailure.narration: The ladder wiggles, but it holds. "Now look along the shore," says Tamsin.

onAssisted.narration: You wedge a stone under it. No wobble. "Now look along the shore," says Tamsin.

driftline.narration: The flood has dumped driftwood, one lonely boot, and a big net of hay tied in yeti knots. The net bobs at the water's edge. "Hay for the snowhorn herd!" says Tamsin. "If it floats off now, it is gone."

net_hook.prompt: Hook the net with the pole and draw it in.
net_hook.narration: You pick a driftwood pole with a fork at the end, like a giant finger.

onSuccess.narration: The fork catches a knot, and the net glides in like a sleepy seal.

onFailure.narration: The net spins away. You snatch a few bundles of hay.

net_drag.prompt: Drag the heavy net out of the river together.
net_drag.narration: You wade in to your knees. The net is full of water and does not want to leave.

onSuccess.narration: Out it comes with a great slurp. The hay is safe.

onFailure.narration: The river wins the tug of war. You save one end, with a few bundles inside.

net_lasso.prompt: Lasso the net with your rope and pull it in.
net_lasso.narration: You tie a loop, twirl it once, twice, and let it fly.

onSuccess.narration: The loop drops over the net like a hat. The hay is safe.

onFailure.narration: The loop lands short. You reel in one end, with a few bundles inside.

net_saved.narration: Then you hear a tiny bell. Out on a gravel bar in the river stand three snowhorn goats, huddled tight. "Goats from the herd!" says Tamsin. "The water cut off their grazing route. They will not swim, and I cannot carry a goat." Tucked in the wet hay, you find a pouch of five coins. Tamsin drops you a supper bundle. "For the goats, or for you."

bar.narration: The bar sits in a brown stream that was not there this morning. "Knee deep and quick," Tamsin warns. The smallest goat sneezes. How will you reach them?

bar_wade.prompt: Everyone grip the rope and wade across together.
bar_wade.narration: The water is cold enough to make your teeth sing.

onSuccess.narration: You climb onto the gravel, dripping and cheering.

onFailure.narration: A hidden hole dunks you. You come up sputtering, still holding the rope.

bar_stones.prompt: Lay a path of flat stones across the stream.
bar_stones.narration: Flat stones lie all over the shore, like dropped plates.

onSuccess.narration: The last stone lands on the bar with a clack.

onFailure.narration: One stone tips you in. You finish the path wet to the knees.

bar_fly.prompt: Use skyward or glide to carry a rope across the stream.
bar_fly.narration: Your winged hero carries a rope over the water.

onSuccess.narration: The line tightens. You cross it hand over hand.

onFailure.narration: The line sags too low. Everyone gets a wet ride across.

bar_leap.prompt: Use leap to jump the stream with a rope.
bar_leap.narration: Your manticore takes the rope in its teeth and crouches.

onSuccess.narration: One big bound, and the rope is across. You cross hand over hand.

onFailure.narration: The bound lands in the shallows, but the rope reaches. You cross with wet boots.

bar_reached.narration: On the bar, the goats lean away from you. The biggest has a cracked horn and a very cross face. The smallest wears a bell that jingles when it shivers. But one of the glassback crabs that live by this river blocks the way. The flood washed out its burrow, so this bar is its house now.

bar_crab.narration: The crab clacks and sidles closer. Its shell is thick, so be patient. It only wants a house.

onVictory.narration: The crab clinks off into a new burrow under the rocks. It leaves a smooth, lucky-looking stone behind. You pocket it.

onDefeat.narration: That shell is too tough. You stumble back until Tamsin's whistle sends the crab off to sulk. It cost you some of the afternoon.

bar_carry.narration: The smallest goat cannot wade water that deep. You lift it together in a rope sling. It jingles in protest.

interaction.cue: Raise or lower your side until the goat rides level.

onSuccess.narration: The sling stays level. The goat jingles like a happy doorbell.

onFailure.narration: The sling tips. The goat paddles the rest, wet and offended.

onAssisted.narration: You steady the sling bit by bit until the goat rides level.

goats.narration: The little goat is safe. The two big goats are not so sure about the water. The biggest one stamps. How will you bring them over?

goat_line.prompt: Take the goats by the ruff and walk them across slowly.
goat_line.narration: The goats plant their hooves like small, hairy anchors.

onSuccess.narration: Hoof by hoof, the goats come across. The biggest even looks pleased.

onFailure.narration: The goats balk and splash everybody. They get across by pushing past you.

goat_lead.prompt: Coax the biggest goat in, and let the other follow its boss.
goat_lead.narration: Goats follow their boss. You walk beside the biggest, murmuring.

onSuccess.narration: It huffs and wades in like a king. The other trots after it.

onFailure.narration: It refuses twice, then charges in and takes everybody with it.

goat_mend.prompt: Use mend on the biggest goat's sore knee.
goat_mend.narration: Your unicorn lays a gentle hoof on the big goat's sore knee.

onSuccess.narration: The big goat trots into the water. The other follows, ears forward.

onFailure.narration: The knee feels better, but the goats still hate water. They cross, complaining.

goat_song.prompt: Use a songkeeper's lullaby to calm the goats.
goat_song.narration: Your songkeeper hums a tune that sounds like a blanket.

onSuccess.narration: The goats stop stamping and follow the song across.

onFailure.narration: The stream is loud, but the goats cross anyway, slowly, with their eyes shut.

goat_bait.prompt: Hold out the supper and lead the goats across, one sniff at a time.
goat_bait.narration: You unwrap the supper bundle. Every goat nose twitches.

onSuccess.narration: The goats follow the smell across like a hairy parade.

onFailure.narration: The goats lunge and eat the supper on the shore. They got across, which was the point.

goat_back.narration: The goats scramble ashore and shake like dogs, spraying everybody. The biggest stamps twice, which seems to mean thank you. "There," says Tamsin. "The herd has all its horns again."

variants.text: Then the biggest goat spots the hay and goes straight for it.

fire.narration: The goats are shivering, and so are you. "Nobody climbs my ladder with stiff fingers," says Tamsin. The driftwood is as wet as everything else. How will you warm up?

fire_build.narration: The inside of a log is often dry. You break the thick pieces open. A tiny flame catches and crackles.

fire_huddle.narration: You press in close and rub everyone dry with hay. Goats are surprisingly hot. The smallest falls asleep on a boot.

fire_smash.narration: One bigfoot whack, and the log cracks open like a nut. Its dry heart lights at the first spark.

rest_fire.narration: For a few minutes, the shore is cozy. Steam rises from the goats, and from your socks. One sock smells like river pudding. "We climb next," says Tamsin. "But nobody has to hurry yet."

rest_socks.narration: Your socks steam on a stick like little flags. The smallest goat nibbles one, thinks about it, and spits it out.

rest_share.narration: You share the supper, a bit for everyone, goats included. Tamsin gets cheese in her feathers. She hands you a bright ribbon from her bag. "We wear these on feast days. Wear it for luck."

rest_story.narration: "Our aerie is above the ridge," says Tamsin. "Our keeper keeps a pass ledger, a book of every road through the peaks. This season it shows a new path he cannot quite believe. He needs someone to walk it."

surge.narration: Crack! Upriver, a slab of ice breaks off the cliffs. A brown wave rolls down the shore with foam on top, like a bad hat. "Ladder! Now!" shouts Tamsin. The goats are already running for a narrow goat track up the cliff.

surge_run.prompt: Everyone run for the ladder before the wave hits.
surge_run.narration: The wet stones slide under your boots like marbles.

onSuccess.narration: You reach the ladder as the wave slaps the rocks behind you.

onFailure.narration: The wave sloshes you against the cliff. You grab the rungs and hold on.

surge_chain.prompt: Lift the goats onto their track, then scramble after them.
surge_chain.narration: You boost the goats up one rump at a time.

onSuccess.narration: The last hoof leaves the shore just as the wave arrives.

onFailure.narration: The wave soaks your boots as you shove the last goat up. It looks deeply offended.

surge_roar.prompt: Use roar to get everyone moving.
surge_roar.narration: Your manticore takes a very big breath.

onSuccess.narration: Nobody argues with that roar. You reach the ladder before the wave does.

onFailure.narration: The roar is loud, but the wave is louder. You get wet to the knees.

surge_brace.prompt: Use brace to take the wave while the others run.
surge_brace.narration: Your thornguard digs in at the foot of the ladder.

onSuccess.narration: The wave splits around the brace. Everyone reaches the ladder with dry elbows.

onFailure.narration: The brace holds, but everyone gets a shove and a splash.

surge_after.narration: The wave breaks around the ladder, which does not budge. "Still standing," says Tamsin. The river settles higher, right where you stood a minute ago.

variants.text: The wave swings the ladder hard. Tamsin hangs on with both claws until it settles. The river settles higher, right where you stood a minute ago.

wave_gap.narration: A smaller wave pulls back with a long hiss. For a moment, the stones by the ladder are bare. "Wait for it," calls Tamsin.

interaction.cue: Wait for the water to pull back, then tap to run to the ladder.

onSuccess.narration: You splash across and grab the bottom rung with dry feet.

onFailure.narration: You go early and get wet to the knees. Tamsin hauls you in.

onAssisted.narration: Tamsin calls the moment, and everyone runs together.

ascend.narration: The ladder is long, and the rungs are wet. The goats are already up top, looking down, as goats do. How will you climb?

climb_line.prompt: Climb the swaying ladder in a line, steadying the climber ahead.

onSuccess.narration: The ladder sways, and so do your stomachs, but nobody lets go.

onFailure.narration: A rung slips, and the line swings like a conga line. You climb the rest on shaky knees.

climb_sling.prompt: Haul the packs up on the rope, then climb with free hands.
climb_sling.narration: You tie the wet packs in a bundle for Tamsin to haul.

onSuccess.narration: Tamsin catches the bundle. Then you climb with free hands.

onFailure.narration: The bundle bonks the cliff, and a pack pops open. You catch your things on the way up.

climb_wings.prompt: Use skyward or glide to carry the packs up.
climb_wings.narration: Your winged hero carries the packs up in short hops.

onSuccess.narration: The packs float up. Then you climb with free hands.

onFailure.narration: A pack splashes into the river. You fish it out, a bit wetter than before.

climb_rally.prompt: Use rally to cheer on tired climbers.
climb_rally.narration: Your songkeeper starts a quick climbing song.

onSuccess.narration: Every climber finds an extra rung of energy.

onFailure.narration: The song is cheerful, but the rungs are wet. You reach the top with sore arms.

top.narration: You flop onto the rock at the top. It is dry. Really dry! A path lined with stacked stones winds along the ridge toward a notch. "The Cairnstep," says Tamsin. "Its keeper is a griffin called Brask. He keeps the pass ledger, our book of roads. He has more ink on his feathers than on the page."

safety.narration: "The river will rise again tomorrow," says Tamsin. "The next travelers will be wetter and more tired than you. A handrail would help them." She drops you a long rope. "Where should we tie it?"

safety_boulder.narration: The old boulder at the top is as steady as a hill. You tie a fat, neat knot. Tamsin tugs it with all her weight. It does not budge.

safety_peg.narration: You hammer a driftwood peg into a crack. Thunk, thunk, thunk. You tie the rope on. The peg holds, even when everyone hangs off it.

safety_buy.narration: Tamsin sells pegs to buy the aerie's ink. She hands you her best one. It rings like a bell. You hammer it deep, and tie the rope on.

safety_done.narration: Tamsin leans her whole chest on the new rail, which is a lot of griffin. It holds. "Somebody will thank you in the dark," she says. She hands you a smooth river charm on a cord. "We give one to anyone who ties a rail."

hay_relay.narration: Tamsin lowers a basket on a rope. "Pass the herd's hay up, hand to hand," she says.

interaction.cue: Catch the hay bundle and pass it to the next friend.

onSuccess.narration: The last bundle thumps into the basket. Tamsin cheers.

onFailure.narration: One bundle splashes away, but the rest make it. "Hay is hay," says Tamsin.

onAssisted.narration: You pass the bundles slowly until the basket is full.

variants.text: Tamsin lowers a basket on a rope. "Even a little hay is worth keeping," she says. "Pass it up, hand to hand."

word.narration: Tamsin shakes the water off her wings. "I must stay by the ladder in case more people come out of that river. But Brask should hear the news. What should he hear first?"

word_river.narration: "Yes," says Tamsin. "If it climbs again tonight, the east bank goes under, and the old path with it. I will send word on the wind. Brask will know before you get there."

word_goats.narration: "Yes," says Tamsin. "The ledger has a line for the herd's route. A short line, but it matters. I will send word on the wind. Brask will know before you get there."

climb.narration: The dry path runs along the ridge toward a notch, up a line of stacked stones. Behind you, the river mutters. You are dry, you are together, and the goats are headed home. "The Cairnstep is next," says Tamsin.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, funny, curious, with real consequences. Describe actions and sensory details directly. Short dialogue. Never use "the kind of thing that", "the sort of thing that", or "it was X, the type of thing that makes you Y" comparisons. Let a character act instead of explaining how the reader should feel.
voiceGuide.vocabulary: Read aloud to an eight-year-old. Concrete words, short sentences, distinct voices.
